title: L¹(ν) approximation of a unit-bounded measurable covector field by smooth unit-bounded test forms supported in an open set
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let ν be a finite Borel measure on ℝ^P, let V ⊆ ℝ^P be open with ν(ℝ^P ∖ V) = 0, and let β : ℝ^P → Covector (Euclid P) n be ν-integrable with covectorEuclideanNorm (β x) ≤ 1 for ν-a.e. x. Then for every ε > 0 there is a smooth compactly supported n-form ω on ℝ^P (IsTestForm ω) with tsupport ω ⊆ V, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x) ≤ 1 for every x, and ∫⁻ ofReal(covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x − β x)) dν(x) < ofReal ε.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Set (Euclid P)) (β : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), IsFiniteMeasure ν → IsOpen V → ν Vᶜ = 0 → Integrable β ν → (∀ᵐ x ∂ν, covectorEuclideanNorm (β x) ≤ 1) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, IsTestForm ω ∧ tsupport ω ⊆ V ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x) ≤ 1) ∧ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x - β x)) ∂ν < ENNReal.ofReal ε
